about: The JSON paths TokenEater decodes from each usage endpoint, with the JSON types its decoder turns into something useful. Hand-derived from the models listed in decodedBy; scripts/check-docs.py fails when a CodingKey name there ends no path here; it matches names, not parents, so a known key decoded under a new parent needs its path added by hand. Types: object, array, string, number, bool, null, absent (key missing from an object that is present). 'number' does not tell integers from floats: a non-integral value in a field the app decodes as Int (Codex limit_window_seconds, reset_at, reset_after_seconds, available_count) fails silently in the app and is not reported. 'displayed: false' marks paths that are decoded but feed no visible feature, so a violation there is reported as active, not breaking.

five_hour.use: Session (5h) usage: menu bar, popover, dashboard hero, widgets, pacing, notifications. Null on plans without a session window (Claude Ultra): every 5h surface steps aside and the glance card shows the week. A missing key still falls back to the limits[] session entry and stays breaking, so a lost flat key is never quiet

five_hour.utilization.use: Session percentage; null or another type falls back to the limits[] session entry, and with none the session window counts as absent

five_hour.resets_at.use: Session countdown, pacing and reset reminder (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

seven_day.use: Weekly usage: menu bar, popover, dashboard, widgets, weekly pacing, notifications. Null or absent falls back to the limits[] weekly_all entry, still reported as breaking so a lost flat key is never quiet

seven_day.utilization.use: Weekly percentage; null or another type falls back to the limits[] weekly_all entry, and with none the week shows a silent 0%

seven_day.resets_at.use: Weekly countdown, pacing and reset reminder (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

seven_day_sonnet.use: Sonnet tile, pacing, notifications; falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Sonnet'

seven_day_sonnet.utilization.use: Sonnet percentage; null or another type falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Sonnet', and with none the limit is treated as not on the plan

seven_day_sonnet.resets_at.use: Sonnet countdown (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

seven_day_opus.use: Opus dashboard tile; falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Opus'

seven_day_opus.utilization.use: Opus percentage; null or another type falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Opus', and with none the limit is treated as not on the plan

seven_day_opus.resets_at.use: Opus countdown (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

seven_day_fable.use: Fable tile, pacing, notifications, menu bar, widget; falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Fable'

seven_day_fable.utilization.use: Fable percentage; null or another type falls back to limits[] weekly_scoped 'Fable', and with none the limit is treated as not on the plan

seven_day_fable.resets_at.use: Fable countdown (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

seven_day_cowork.utilization.use: Cowork percentage; null or another type hides the tile (unknown, not 0%)

seven_day_cowork.resets_at.use: Decoded, not displayed (the Cowork tile shows no countdown)

seven_day_oauth_apps.use: Decoded into UsageStore.oauthAppsPct, which nothing reads

extra_usage.use: Extra Credits card, its widget, menu bar EC%, extra-credits notification

extra_usage.is_enabled.use: Required: missing or mistyped drops the whole Extra Credits pool

extra_usage.monthly_limit.use: Extra Credits limit (minor units); a type change drops the pool

extra_usage.used_credits.use: Extra Credits spent (minor units); a type change drops the pool

extra_usage.utilization.use: Extra Credits percentage; a type change drops the pool

extra_usage.currency.use: Currency formatting (USD fallback); a type change drops the pool

extra_usage.disabled_reason.use: Decoded, read by tests only; a type change still drops the pool

limits.use: The only source of Fable on migrated accounts, plus the fallbacks for five_hour, seven_day, Sonnet and Opus. Absent is still decoded (old-shape accounts) but reported as breaking, since Fable goes with it

limits[].use: Decoded lossily: an entry that is not an object is dropped alone

limits[].kind.use: Matched against 'session', 'weekly_all' and 'weekly_scoped'; another type leaves the entry unmatched

limits[].group.use: Decoded, unused; another type reads as nil

limits[].percent.use: The matched pool's percentage; null or another type drops that entry's bucket (unknown, not 0%)

limits[].resets_at.use: The matched pool's countdown (ISO 8601, or Unix seconds or milliseconds)

limits[].scope.use: Null or absent marks the account-wide session and weekly_all pools; any object, even a malformed one, marks a scoped entry

limits[].scope.model.id.use: Decoded, unused; another type reads as nil

limits[].scope.model.display_name.use: Matched case-insensitively against Fable, Sonnet, Opus; another type leaves the entry unmatched

ignoredCodingKeys.resetCreditsAvailable: TokenEater's own flat key in codex.json, never sent by the API

plan_type.use: Plan badge (popover, Settings > Providers, diagnostic); falls back to the JWT claim

rate_limit.use: Account windows; null on API-key accounts

rate_limit.primary_window.use: A usage window, classified by duration, never by position

rate_limit.secondary_window.use: A usage window, classified by duration, never by position

rate_limit.primary_window.used_percent.use: Gauges, menu bar, popover, dashboard, widget, pacing, notifications; defaults to a silent 0

rate_limit.primary_window.limit_window_s.use: Window classification (session, weekly, other); defaults to 0, i.e. 'other'

rate_limit.primary_window.reset_at.use: Countdown, pacing, reset reminders and reset detection (Unix seconds)

rate_limit.secondary_window.used_percent.use: Gauges, menu bar, popover, dashboard, widget, pacing, notifications; defaults to a silent 0

rate_limit.secondary_window.limit_window.use: Window classification (session, weekly, other); defaults to 0, i.e. 'other'

rate_limit.secondary_window.reset_at.use: Countdown, pacing, reset reminders and reset detection (Unix seconds)

additional_rate_limits.use: Per-model pools, decoded lossily, not displayed

additional_rate_limits[].rate_limit.use: Required: entries without it are dropped

credits.use: Credits footer pills and medium widget

credits.balance.use: Credits balance (a decimal string; a number shows '-')

spend_control.use: Workspace spending cap, decoded, not displayed

spend_control.individual_limit.use: Decoded, not displayed; a bare number or decimal string still reads as the cap alone, the shape an earlier codex.json carried

spend_control.individual_limit.source.use: Who set the cap, decoded, not displayed

spend_control.individual_limit.limit.use: The cap, a decimal string upstream, also read as a number; not displayed

rate_limit_reached_type.use: Why requests are blocked, decoded, not displayed

rate_limit_reset_credits.use: Banked reset credits: footer pill and widget
